title: AETHER SIGIL: CHRONICLES OF THE CAPSULE REALMS
creative_direction: Original 3D anime tactical monster-board adventure with capsule deployment, terrain strategy, evolving creatures, rival towers, Symbols, exploration, and cinematic battles.
ip_note: All names, creatures, characters, symbols, maps, dialogue, mechanics terminology, and visual directions in this package are original concepts intended to avoid copying Yu-Gi-Oh! characters, monsters, artwork, logos, or exact maps.
core_loop: Explore a tower and unlock its stages.
Find or earn capsules containing original monsters.
Use movement, attacks, terrain effects, positioning, and abilities.
Defeat rival teams or destroy the enemy Symbol.
Earn materials, evolve monsters, unlock new capsules, and challenge the next tower.

sample_lines: Hero: Capsule ready. Let's see what answers the battlefield gives us.
Rival: You brought power. I brought a plan.
Rival: You thought that node was safe? That's exactly where I wanted you.
Hero: The Symbol is exposed. Everyone, advance!
Rival: Not bad. Next tower, I won't give you the same opening.
